subject: DISTANCE - analysis of data with many zeroes

messages.author: f5896668b3b7cfdc
messages.subject: DISTANCE - analysis of data with many zeroes
parts:
Hi folks:

I'm working on analyzing a data set with Program DISTANCE in which I
have a very uneven distribution of detections between transects. We
were using transects to detect a variety of types of animal sign (spoor,
scat, etc.) and at one site had several transects with zero detections.
Is there a special way to handle those transects in DISTANCE?

Thanks for any suggestions.

erika

messages.subject: Re: DISTANCE - analysis of data with many zeroes
parts:
You enter the transect but it will have no sightings. Beyond that there
is no special treatment and not sure what you are asking. --jeff
